# SYNTHETIC vLLM /metrics golden fixture.
#
# This file reproduces the *shape* of a real vLLM Prometheus text exposition (HELP/TYPE lines,
# series names, and label sets) for GPU-free parser development. It is NOT captured from a real
# vLLM instance: no GPU is available in this build environment.
#
# Before the paid GPU run, replace this file with an actual scrape captured from the pinned vLLM
# image digest, and record that digest alongside it (design spec v1, "Metric names are pinned,
# not assumed"; design spec v2, "Requires a real vLLM/GPU" list).
#
# The two series this parser reads are pinned by name: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (V1, used here)
# with vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc as its V0 alias, and vllm:num_requests_waiting. Everything else
# below is unrelated-series noise the parser must ignore.
# HELP vllm:cache_config_info Information of the LLMEngine CacheConfig
# TYPE vllm:cache_config_info gauge
vllm:cache_config_info{block_size="16",cache_dtype="auto"} 1
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests currently running on GPU.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running{engine="0",model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 3
# HELP vllm:num_requests_swapped Number of requests swapped to CPU.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_swapped gauge
vllm:num_requests_swapped{engine="0",model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 0
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting{engine="0",model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 5
# HELP vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc GPU KV-cache usage. 1 means 100 percent usage.
# TYPE vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{engine="0",model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 0.42
# HELP vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds Histogram of time to first token in seconds.
# TYPE vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds histogram
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct",le="0.001"} 0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct",le="0.5"} 10
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct",le="+Inf"} 12
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 1.5
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct"} 12
# HELP python_gc_objects_collected_total Objects collected during gc
# TYPE python_gc_objects_collected_total counter
python_gc_objects_collected_total{generation="0"} 1234.0
# HELP process_start_time_seconds Start time of the process since unix epoch in seconds.
# TYPE process_start_time_seconds gauge
process_start_time_seconds 1.753400000e+09
